title: Sound Painting
shareTitle: Sound Painting — Paint What You Hear
description: Choose a musical brush, paint glowing paper ribbons with your finger, then replay the colors and notes together. A creative music-and-art game for ages 5–6.
learningGoals: Connect audible pitch and rhythm with color, shape, and movement
Explore slow, bouncy, and quick expressive gesture qualities
Practice free mark-making and fine-motor control without a right answer
interactionModel: three musical brush modes with one-finger free drawing, color choice, undo, clear, semantic replay, local save, and PNG keepsake export
feedbackModel: Every mark paints immediately and emits a coordinated synthesized note; recorded teacher prompts model movement, while replay and a brief celebration affirm the complete painting.

privacy.storage: up to six semantic paintings in localStorage on the current device
